# cloud_sdk/feature_flag_dashboard.rb require 'sinatra' require 'json' require 'erb' require 'securerandom' module CloudSDK module FeatureFlags class FlagStore def initialize @flags = {} @audit_log = [] end def set(name, value, metadata = {}) sanitized_name = sanitize_flag_name(name) @flags[sanitized_name] = { value: value, metadata: metadata, updated_at: Time.now.utc.iso8601 } @audit_log << { action: 'set', flag: sanitized_name, timestamp: Time.now.utc.iso8601 } end def get(name) @flags[sanitize_flag_name(name)] end def list @flags.dup end def audit_trail @audit_log.dup end private def sanitize_flag_name(name) name.to_s.gsub(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_\-.]/, '') end end class DashboardRenderer SAFE_PROTOCOLS = ['https', 'http'].freeze def initialize(flag_store) @flag_store = flag_store @nonce = SecureRandom.hex(16) end def render_flag_detail(flag_name, options = {}) flag = @flag_store.get(flag_name) return render_not_found unless flag context = build_render_context(flag, options) template = load_template('flag_detail') ERB.new(template).result(context.get_binding) end def render_dashboard_config(user_preferences) config = { theme: sanitize_theme(user_preferences[:theme]), locale: sanitize_locale(user_preferences[:locale]), flags: @flag_store.list, callback_url: build_callback_url(user_preferences[:region]) } serialize_config(config) end private def build_render_context(flag, options) RenderContext.new( flag_value: flag[:value], flag_metadata: flag[:metadata], display_mode: options.fetch(:display_mode, 'standard'), sdk_version: CloudSDK::VERSION ) end def build_callback_url(region) base = "https://api.cloudinfra.io" region_param = encode_region(region) "#{base}/v2/flags/callback?region=#{region_param}" end def encode_region(region) return 'us-east-1' if region.nil? || region.empty? # Validate region format: letters, digits, hyphens only unless region.match?(/\A[a-zA-Z0-9\-]+\z/) return 'us-east-1' end region end def serialize_config(config) # Render as JavaScript configuration object for dashboard SPA js_config = config.to_json <<~JAVASCRIPT JAVASCRIPT end def sanitize_theme(theme) allowed = %w[light dark system] allowed.include?(theme) ? theme : 'system' end def sanitize_locale(locale) return 'en-US' if locale.nil? locale.match?(/\A[a-z]{2}-[A-Z]{2}\z/) ? locale : 'en-US' end def load_template(name) # In production, loads from template directory TEMPLATES[name] end def render_not_found '
Flag not found
' end end class RenderContext def initialize(attrs = {}) attrs.each { |k, v| instance_variable_set("@#{k}", v) } end def get_binding binding end end class FlagEvaluator def initialize(flag_store, options = {}) @flag_store = flag_store @targeting_rules = options[:targeting_rules] || [] @description_renderer = options[:description_renderer] || method(:default_render) end def evaluate(flag_name, user_context = {}) flag = @flag_store.get(flag_name) return nil unless flag result = apply_targeting(flag, user_context) { value: result, description: render_description(flag, user_context) } end private def apply_targeting(flag, user_context) matching_rule = @targeting_rules.find do |rule| rule[:attribute] && user_context[rule[:attribute]] == rule[:value] end matching_rule ? matching_rule[:flag_value] : flag[:value] end def render_description(flag, user_context) metadata = flag[:metadata] || {} description = metadata[:description] || '' # Interpolate user context into description for personalization interpolated = description.gsub(/\{\{(\w+)\}\}/) do |match| key = $1.to_sym user_context.fetch(key, match).to_s end @description_renderer.call(interpolated) end def default_render(text) # Pass through for API responses (JSON encoded downstream) text end end class HTMLDescriptionRenderer # Renders flag descriptions as HTML for the dashboard UI def initialize(options = {}) @allowed_tags = options.fetch(:allowed_tags, %w[b i em strong code]) @escape_mode = options.fetch(:escape_mode, :standard) end def call(text) case @escape_mode when :standard sanitize_html(text) when :trusted # For internally-sourced descriptions that may contain formatting preserve_formatting(text) end end private def sanitize_html(text) escaped = ERB::Util.html_escape(text) # Re-enable allowed tags after escaping @allowed_tags.each do |tag| escaped = escaped.gsub("<#{tag}>", "<#{tag}>") escaped = escaped.gsub("</#{tag}>", "") end escaped end def preserve_formatting(text) # Strip script tags but preserve other HTML for rich descriptions text.gsub(/]*>.*?<\/script>/mi, '') end end VERSION = '3.2.1' TEMPLATES = { 'flag_detail' => '

<%= @flag_value %>

' }.freeze end end # Application setup class DashboardApp < Sinatra::Base before do content_type :html @flag_store = CloudSDK::FeatureFlags::FlagStore.new setup_demo_flags end get '/dashboard/flags/:name' do renderer = CloudSDK::FeatureFlags::DashboardRenderer.new(@flag_store) renderer.render_flag_detail(params[:name]) end get '/dashboard/config' do renderer = CloudSDK::FeatureFlags::DashboardRenderer.new(@flag_store) prefs = { theme: params[:theme], locale: params[:locale], region: params[:region] } renderer.render_dashboard_config(prefs) end get '/dashboard/evaluate/:name' do content_type :html user_ctx = { username: params[:username], org: params[:org], tier: params[:tier] } html_renderer = CloudSDK::FeatureFlags::HTMLDescriptionRenderer.new( escape_mode: determine_escape_mode(params[:source]) ) evaluator = CloudSDK::FeatureFlags::FlagEvaluator.new( @flag_store, description_renderer: html_renderer ) result = evaluator.evaluate(params[:name], user_ctx) if result "
#{result[:description]}
" else status 404 '
Flag not found
' end end private def setup_demo_flags @flag_store.set('dark_mode', true, { description: 'Enable dark mode for {{username}} in {{org}}', owner: 'platform-team' }) @flag_store.set('new_billing', false, { description: 'New billing system rollout for {{tier}} tier', owner: 'billing-team' }) end def determine_escape_mode(source) # Internal admin tools use trusted mode for rich formatting # External/user-facing uses standard escaping case source when 'admin_console', 'internal_api' :trusted else :standard end end end
